name: Reyhan
description: A military commander who refused to kneel to a dragon, became the last khan of the Abzan, and died protecting other khans in the khanfall.

timeline.summary: Daghatar convenes twenty Abzan advisors at Mer-Ek, and Reyhan and Merel argue between striking at Dromoka and enduring.
timeline.quote: We bring down Dromoka, and her brood will scatter.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Reyhan, Yasova, and Tasigur arrive at Dirgur and bicker.
Reyhan blames Yasova for the deaths of thousands, but Shu Yun interposes under his truce, and the khans forgive her.
timeline.quote: Shu Yun interposed himself between Reyhan and Yasova.

timeline.summary: The khans disagree over whether to open the cocoon, kill Ugin, or kill the brood-lords; Shu Yun insists on balance and seeking Ugin.
timeline.quote: The destruction of the dragons is no better than the destruction of the clans.

timeline.summary: The khans realize someone leaked the summit, and Alesha suspects Shu Yun, who denies it; Tasigur has vanished.
timeline.quote: Someone must have told them about our little summit," said Reyhan.

timeline.summary: Tasigur's guards attack, and Alesha's party kills them.
timeline.quote: Alesha and her bodyguards charged, and the room erupted in chaos.

timeline.summary: Reyhan is killed by Silumgar while holding off dragons as Yasova and Alesha escape across the lake.
timeline.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

timeline.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
timeline.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

timeline.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

relations.note: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.
relations.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

relations.note: She refused to kneel to the dragonlord.
relations.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

pages_say.description: Joint commander of three Houses' forces and the Abzan's most consistently successful military leader, who advocates striking at Dromoka's brood.
A stout Abzan commander who styles herself khan of the few Abzan not following Daghatar and dies defending the khans from Silumgar.
The khan of the remaining free Abzan, who dies securing an escape for Yasova and Alesha.
A military commander who refused to kneel to a dragon, became the last khan of the Abzan, and died protecting other khans in the khanfall.
